description: This file defines an interface named ConfigurationInterface in the Aws\EndpointDiscovery namespace. It specifies methods for accessing endpoint discovery configuration options such as 'enabled' status and 'cache_limit'.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for endpoint discovery configuration options, including methods to check if endpoint discovery is enabled, retrieve cache limit, and export configuration as an array.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether or not endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache limit, if available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
